metadata.title: Lululemon shares sink after an outlook cut, and other early market movers - MarketWatch

content.text:
4 days ago
Lululemon shares sink after an outlook cut, and other early market movers
Here are some of the stocks making notable moves in Friday's premarket action:
Guidewire Software stock is down 14% after the insurance-technology group's full-year guidance disappointed.
Lululemon shares are dropping 12% after the yoga-wear maker trimmed its outlook, citing a feud with its founder and offerings that haven't resonated with customers.
Quantinuum stock is down 3%, following a lackluster Nasdaq debut. Shares of the quantum company surged 13% above an initial-public-offering price of $60, but ended Thursday up just 0.6% at $60.38.
Samsara stock is down 3% following disappointment after the software group said second-quarter guidance will just meet Wall Street forecasts.
Tesla stock rose 0.2%, after an upgrade by JPMorgan to neutral from underweight.
